what: Bench fixtures for tools/posq/closure_interface.py — small self-contained loglik closures with analytically exact truth values. Truths are exact closed forms (the exact register); estimator outputs are float-class R3 and gated by recorded tolerances derived from a measured 8-seed sweep (2026-07-20 UTC, numpy 2.4.1 / scipy 1.17.1 / mpmath 1.3.0).
harness: closures rebuilt from 'kind' + 'params' by selftest_closure_interface.py (no pickles); formulas in FIXTURES_README.md

fixtures.truth_form: Z = e^c exactly; lnZ = c = -7/2 exact

fixtures.loglik_form: loglik(h) = sum_b [ d_b * ln(h_b) - h_b * E_b ], h_b = u_b (uniform prior per bin)
fixtures.truth_form: Z = prod_b Integral_0^1 h^{d_b} e^{-E_b h} dh = prod_b E_b^{-(d_b+1)} * gamma_lower(d_b+1, E_b); 30-digit value via mpmath dps=40 (derivation in FIXTURES_README.md)
fixtures.truth_register: exact closed form in incomplete-gamma values; decimal computed at 40 dps
fixtures.note: hazard-field-SHAPED toy only: 7 bins, bins 3 and 6 carrying elevated event counts (a 'crisis' texture). It demonstrates a hazard-field-style closure through the harness; it is NOT a full hazard-field model (no covariates, no gamma slot heterogeneity — those belong inside the consumer's own closure).

plants.what: closure returning shape (n,2) — check_closure must raise ClosureInterfaceError
closure returning NaN at probed points — check_closure must raise ClosureInterfaceError
infer_hazard_field() and posterior_draws() must raise ClosureObjectMissing with non-empty reason and unlock
